newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Nan Ya Jan-March sales up 9.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Nan Ya Jan-March sales up 9.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Nan Ya Plastics Corp, Taiwan's largest private industrial firm, said on Tuesday sales revenue rose 9.3 percent in the first three months of 1997 to T$21.976 billion from T$20.099 billion a year earlier.
For March alone, sales rose 8.2 percent to T$8.09 billion from T$7.475 billion in March 1996, the company said in a statement.
The March sales total was up 26.6 percent from February's T$6.388 billion, it added.
The statement did not give profit figures.
Nan Ya said it has set a sales target of T$94.921 billion for 1997.
The company is a key member of the Formosa Plastics group.
